Opt-in human-in-the-loop bash approval (Allow/Deny cards, fail-closed timeout), one-message"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" /pair onboarding, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, daily latest"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-feishu-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The SDK canary runs daily against the *latest* `deepseek-harness-sdk` and `lark-channel-sdk` release"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s (not the pinned versions this repo ships), so a breaking upstream change gets caught within a day "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"instead of silently bit-rotting."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A Feishu (Lark) channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): message a Feishu bot, it runs a `dsh` a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"gent turn, the reply comes back to the chat."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**This is an independent community project. It is not built, maintained, or endorsed by DeepSeek.** "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"It drives `dsh` entirely through its public Python SDK (`deepseek-harness-sdk`) — a subprocess bound"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ary, no forked/patched harness code."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What this is"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- A production-grade Feishu bot bridge: fail-closed allowlist, one-time card nonces, per-chat verbos"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ity, sticky sessions, both `ws` and `webhook` transports.
- The thin adapter that talks to `deepseek"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"-harness-sdk` lives in one file, `src/dsh_feishu_bridge/dsh_adapter.py`, and the SDK version is pinn"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ed exactly — the harness is a v0.1 developer preview that documents breaking changes between release"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"s. That same adapter also carries a small capability-detection shim (probes the installed SDK's actu"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"al `DeepSeekHarnessConfig` fields via `inspect.signature`, never a hardcoded version check) so the n"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ightly SDK canary — which installs the latest pre-release unpinned — keeps passing across a breaking"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" field rename instead of just going red; see `docs/architecture.md` "SDK compat"."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quickstart (5 minutes)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Set your credentials as environment variables — never in a committed file:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Run it:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Message the bot in Feishu — from a **private chat**, send `/pair <code>` using the one-time code pri"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nted to the bridge's console at startup (see "Getting your open_id" below). A correct code puts your"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" `open_id` on the allowlist immediately, no restart needed. Anything else from an unlisted `open_id`"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" is silently rejected."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Getting your open_id"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The bridge prints a one-time pairing code to its own console the moment it starts:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Security posture"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Fail-closed by default.** No configured `FEISHU_ALLOWED_OPEN_IDS` means every sender is rejected"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" — there is no implicit allow-all. This is deliberate: an agent bridge with a blank allowlist would "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"otherwise let anyone in your tenant run arbitrary agent turns.
- **Webhook mode requires both a veri"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"fication token and an encrypt key.** Without either, the webhook route is never registered — the pro"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"cess refuses to boot half-configured rather than silently accepting unverified events. The encrypt k"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ey is not optional: a verification token alone is a static value carried in the request body, not a "},{"id":"p22s7","text":"per-request signature, so it cannot authenticate where a request actually came from.
- **Every webho"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ok request is signature-, timestamp-, and replay-verified at this bridge's own boundary** — before i"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"t is ever handed to the underlying SDK. `X-Lark-Signature` is checked against `sha256(timestamp + no"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"nce + encrypt_key + body)`; the timestamp must fall within a 5-minute window of "now"; and a `(times"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"tamp, nonce)` pair already seen is rejected as a replay. A request that fails any of these checks ge"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"ts a `401` and never reaches message handling. The one deliberate exception is Feishu's own "save re"},{"id":"p22s13","text":"quest URL" console step: that handshake is never signed (no subscription is confirmed yet to sign ag"},{"id":"p22s14","text":"ainst), so this bridge checks only `FEISHU_VERIFICATION_TOKEN` for it and echoes the challenge back "},{"id":"p22s15","text":"directly — the same, already-mandatory check the underlying SDK would otherwise perform.
- **Card bu"},{"id":"p22s16","text":"ttons (session-switch, tool-approval) use one-time, identity-bound nonces.** A nonce is minted for o"},{"id":"p22s17","text":"ne exact action + session (+ tool call, for approval); a second click, a replayed nonce, or a tamper"},{"id":"p22s18","text":"ed card value is rejected without being honored.
- **Sessions are owned by the chat that created the"},{"id":"p22s19","text":"m.** `/sessions` only lists (and `/switch` only accepts) sessions owned by the requesting chat — eve"},{"id":"p22s20","text":"n between two allowlisted chats, one can't list or hijack another's session id and start receiving i"},{"id":"p22s21","text":"ts replies. Tool-approval decisions apply the same ownership check server-side, not just via nonce s"},{"id":"p22s22","text":"-approval decisions apply the same ownership check server-side, not just via nonce scoping.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Limitations (v1, by design)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"These are deliberate scope decisions driven by what `deepseek-harness-sdk` v0.1 actually exposes tod"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ay — documented here rather than silently missing:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **No incremental streaming.** `DeepSeekHarness.run()` is a synchronous call that blocks until the "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"turn is idle; the SDK's `on_notification` hook receives raw protocol notifications mid-call, but the"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ir event schema isn't part of the documented v0.1 contract. So the bridge posts one status line at t"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"urn start and the full reply once the turn completes — not a token-by-token stream like some other b"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ridges.
- **Sessions are sticky only within one bridge process.** A restart starts a fresh `DeepSeek"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"Harness` subprocess, and cross-restart resume via a shared `session_root` isn't a behavior the SDK's"},{"id":"p25s7","text":" v0.1 docs commit to — so this bridge doesn't build undocumented persistence on top of it. A chat's "},{"id":"p25s8","text":"sticky session pointer and its `/quiet`/`/verbose` preference both reset on restart.
- **Text messag"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"es only** — no voice, image, or file attachments, and no topic/thread replies (one sticky session pe"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"r chat would silently cross wires across threads).
- **One model configuration per bridge process** "},{"id":"p25s11","text":"— provider/model/cordis composition are subprocess-wide, not per-chat. There's no `/agent`-style reb"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"ind command; run a second bridge process (different port, different Feishu app or allowlist) if you "},{"id":"p25s13","text":"need a second configuration.
- **One pairing code at a time, self-service only.** `/pair` can only a"},{"id":"p25s14","text":"dd the *sender's own* `open_id` — there's no way to pair someone else's account for them, and only o"},{"id":"p25s15","text":"ne code is ever live per process. A second person needing access waits for (or the operator triggers"},{"id":"p25s16","text":") a restart to get a fresh code."}],"truncated":true}
